newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks open a bit higher, but gains limited.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks open a bit higher, but gains limited.

text.p: Tokyo stocks rose slightly in early Tuesday morning trade, as the yen's continuing retreat against the dollar supported major exporter issues.
But gains in the overall index were capped by sales of shares in financial firms and property-related issues, brokers said.
The 225-share Nikkei average climbed 11.40 points or 0.06 percent to trade at 17,727.07 in the first 10 minutes of trade. Its June Nikkei futures rose 80 points to 17,730.
"If it (the Nikkei) doesn't recover much in the morning, it could head lower again," said Kenji Karikomi, deputy general manager at Daiwa Securities Co Ltd.
